name: dsh-ace-music
description: ACE Music MCP server for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in once, then write songs, continue a melody, upload audio, inspect and download tracks as native acemusic_* tools. Includes a MusicXML-to-ABC converter so an agent can compose the score. Fills the OAuth gap in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client.
author: Gladess1102

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check src/net.js && node --check src/oauth.js && node --check src/mcp.js
scripts.plugincheck: node --check index.js && test -f cordis.patch.yml && test -f locale/zh.json && test -f icon.svg
